question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

(1) She hang up / (2) the clothes / (3) in the closet every day. / (4) No error
solution:
Here, correct answer is **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
__
 
• The error in the sentence** "She hang up the clothes in the closet every day" **is the incorrect verb form.
 
• The error is in the subject-verb agreement.
 
• The subject **"She"** requires the corresponding verb form, which should be** "hangs" **instead of **"hang"** to match the singular subject.
 
• **"Hang" **should be changed to its correct past tense form, **"hung,"** to agree with the subject **"She."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 ​

Correct sentence:* **She **hung**__ up the clothes in the closet every day.*
